verdict.rationale: Pulley's docs show a comprehensive cap table system covering share classes, certificates, SAFEs, RSAs, RSUs, convertible notes, option grants, stakeholder profiles, migration from Excel/Carta, and downloadable cap table history — positioning it as a live source of truth used by admins, and its 409A/compliance/transfer-agent features imply investor/auditor reliance. Missing for 10: explicit third-party investor/auditor testimonials confirming trust in Pulley as source of truth, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
